programs.title: Ama Gloria
programs.desc: Cléo loves her nanny Gloria more than anything. When Gloria must return to homeland, the two must make the most of their last summer together.

programs.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programs.desc: Growing up poor in Madras, India, Srinivasa Ramanujan Iyengar earns admittance to Cambridge University during WWI, where he becomes a pioneer in mathematical theories with the guidance of his professor, G.H. Hardy.

programs.title: The Unlikely Pilgrimage Of Harold Fry
programs.desc: Harold, a quiet and seemingly ordinary man in his sixties, is shaken when he learns that his old friend Queenie is dying in a distant hospice. On impulse, he sets out to mail a letter to her, but instead begins walking, convinced that as long as he keeps moving, she will live. His journey spans 450 miles, forcing him to confront memories, regrets, and the growing concern and loneliness of his wife, Maureen, who is left behind at home.

programs.title: Eighth Grade
programs.desc: Kayla Day is an 13-year-old eighth grade student finishing her final week at a public middle school in the state of New York. She posts motivational videos on YouTube about confidence and self-image that get almost no views. Meanwhile, Mark, her single father, struggles to connect with her and break her reliance on social media.

programs.title: Juliet, Naked
programs.desc: Annie (Rose Bryne) is stuck in a long-term relationship with Duncan (Chris O’Dowd) – an obsessive fan of obscure rocker Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). When the acoustic demo of Tucker's hit record from 25 years ago surfaces, its release leads to a life-changing encounter with the elusive rocker himself. Based on the novel by Nick Hornby, Juliet, Naked is a comic account of life’s second chances.

programs.title: The Rover
programs.desc: Set in a chaotic future, this Outback saga follows loner Eric's brutal ordeal when a criminal gang takes his car and leaves him nowhere with nothing.
